reason: braces 3.0.3 is the newest release and the advisory covers every release up to it, so there is no patched release. It reaches the tree through @graphql-codegen/cli > micromatch (a devDependency that runs code generation over this repository's own codegen.ts patterns) and through @simulacrum/foundation-simulator > http-proxy-middleware > micromatch. The simulator is a production dependency, but its proxy middleware (dist/middleware/proxy.mjs) calls createProxyMiddleware with a target and no pathFilter, and http-proxy-middleware reaches micromatch only when a glob pathFilter is configured (the configured glob is the pattern; the request path is only the string matched), so no brace pattern is ever matched at runtime, and DigitalPuddle's own source never imports either package. Rationale and exposure: docs/dependency-policy-exception-braces-nested-patterns.md. Remove this entry once a patched braces exists or micromatch drops braces 3.
